sentences.text: In a dusty town, two gangs are ready.
The Red Gang and the Blue Gang want gold.
They want the gold from the big mine.
They know the gangs are here.
The Red Gang walks in first.
The Blue Gang comes in next.
"This is our town!" says the leader of the Red Gang.
"No! This is our town!" says the leader of the Blue Gang.
The people in the saloon are quiet.
The two leaders stare at each other.
The Red Gang and the Blue Gang fight.
They throw chairs and punch each other.
The sheriff says, "You cannot fight here.
The gangs look at each other.
They know the sheriff is right.
The town is safe for now.
